sections.name: Gulon mein rang kahan hai tere badan ki tarah, Tera badan hai sitaron ki anjuman ki tarah
Yeh hai fareb-e-nazar ya bahaar ka mausam, Saja hua hai gulistan mera dulhan ki tarah
Woh zindagi to nahi zindagi ka maatam hai, Jo zindagi ho watan hi mein be-watan ki tarah
Jahan bhi main ne qadam apna rakh diya Mukhtar, Mehak uthe wahin kaante bhi nastaran ki tarah
